This '''Imperial Governor''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], who made a deal with the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pyash Yopayomba]]. In exchange for her instigating a planetary civil war during the [[Portage Moon Festival]], the governor would give Yopayomba complete control of [[Ando/Legends|Ando's]] oceans.<ref name="Ando">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030703ando|text=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men|int=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men}}</ref>

The governor's fate is unknown after the [[Battle of Portage Moon]].
